ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central region comprising approximately 85% of the visible surface, bounded by a thick, low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zone across both lobes. Low-intensity black banding along the superior trailing edge and lobe tips. Discrete mid-to-low intensity circular spots (5-7 count) distributed on the distal regions. Tan-colored mid-intensity patches located in the mid-section of the right lobe (image-right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation; vertex angle is acute, with depth extending significantly toward the peduncle connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude (larger notches) visible near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a convex sweep toward the outer distal edges of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark-pixel clusters detected: three distinct clusters on the outer right lobe (image-right) and two on the mid-left lobe (image-left).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, tan-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed diagonally across the inner right lobe (image-right) and horizontal scratches on the far-left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Tan-yellowish pigmentation patches (likely biofilm or scarring) on the central-right lobe; jagged erosion and irregular tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy black pigmentation 'caps' at both distal tips that extend inward along the trailing edge more than the leading edge.
